## Checklist before merging

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass locally
- [ ] I checked the change in the browser (`npm run dev`), on desktop and on a phone-sized viewport if it touches the UI
- [ ] Any change to the data format or the model is in `docs/SPEC.md` first
- [ ] I regenerated `public/races.json` with the exporter if the data or the exporter changed
- [ ] I updated the README's Project structure tree if I added, removed or renamed files or folders
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] I did not leave debug code or temporary comments in
